calculation.formula: Apply allowance deduction unless gross wages exceed the period threshold; then apply the all-status period schedule and add any requested extra withholding.

supplementalWages.paidWithRegularWages: Treat total as one regular payroll payment
supplementalWages.paidSeparatelyAlternative: Add supplemental wages to preceding regular wages, calculate on aggregate, subtract tax withheld from preceding payroll

residencyAndWorkRules.mandatoryRule: A Rhode Island employer withholds when wages are subject to federal withholding and any part is for services performed in Rhode Island.
residencyAndWorkRules.nonresidentRule: Rhode Island employment compensation remains subject to Rhode Island withholding regardless of employee residence.
residencyAndWorkRules.residentOutsideRhodeIsland: An out-of-state employer may voluntarily withhold Rhode Island tax as a convenience for a Rhode Island resident; the booklet does not impose mandatory resident-state withholding on wholly out-of-state services.

paymentFrequencies.condition: Withholding at least $600 in any calendar month
paymentFrequencies.due: Next banking day after Sunday-Saturday week

paymentFrequencies.condition: Withholding at least $50 but under $600 in a calendar month
paymentFrequencies.due: 20 days after non-quarter-ending month; RI-941 due last day after quarter-ending month

paymentFrequencies.condition: Withholding under $50 in every calendar month
paymentFrequencies.due: Last day of month after quarter

otherElectronicTriggers: Combined annual liability for all Division taxes at least $5,000

quarterlyReconciliation.due: Last day of month after quarter

filing.employeeStatements: Federal W-2 compliance satisfies state statement requirement.
